title: Russian Roulette???  Is this my day?  Good luck.
text:
Russian Roulette??? Is this my day? Good luck.. Received this exact unit as a gift and it was working fine for about a week. Went to make coffee and nothing, no power, lights nothing. Couldn’t return because as I said earlier it was gifted.
Went on Amazon and ordered the identical unit through one of Amazons well trusted venders.
Upon receiving I immediately plugged the unit into the outlet and all was good. Next morning went to make my morning brew, nothing. No power to the machine whatsoever.
Now no coffee and the brand new machine I just purchased is garbage. Went online to see if there were any tricks on resetting the unit. No, everyone had to return. There had to be 60 people online that purchased these machines with identical problems. You would think a company that has a lot to say about being number one in coffee should have stepped up before it went this far.
Look what it does? I use to love this company and I currently own their other machines as well.
After this last machine I stay away from Keurig. I’m sure many many others will do the same. I submitted pics so you don’t make the same mistake.
Identical units don’t break down with the exact problems within a week or two unless it’s a call back type situation.
Keurig knows very well what I’m saying here. Be the company you say you are and pull these garbage makers off the shelves because all their doing is making long term Keurig users a thing of the past. I will never accept another machine from Keurig due to this. Go online and see for yourself how many machines with the identical problems. A real same guys.
Keurig K-Supreme Plus Coffee Maker ( stay far far away)).

product_metadata.title: Keurig K-Supreme Plus Coffee Single Serve Maker, 5 Cup Sizes And 78 oz. Reservoir
features: MultiStream Technology: The K-Supreme Plus coffee maker features MultiStream Technology, an innovative way to more evenly saturate the coffee grounds in every K-Cup pod. This technique uses multiple streams of water to saturate the grounds and extracts full flavor and aroma from your K-Cup pod, so you can enjoy an exceptionally flavorful experience every time you brew

Customization: Looking to customize your perfect cup? Use the Strong button for a stronger, more intense coffee taste or brew hot over ice for a refreshingly delicious iced coffee. You can choose from three strength and three temperature settings
Capacity: No matter what you prefer, you can enjoy 4, 6, 8, 10, or 12 oz. of your favorite coffee, tea, cocoa, and more – all freshly brewed in minutes
Large Reservoir: The K-Supreme Plus coffee maker is travel mug friendly, and the large 78 oz. removable reservoir makes refilling a snap
Display: With a modern digital display screen and a sleek stainless-steel metal wrap, it’s a striking standout in any kitchen
